summary: Tested new Discover and Profile Gallery features end-to-end. All 13 backend pytest cases pass (100%). Frontend Discover and ProfileGallery flows verified in browser. Existing endpoints regression-checked (auth/me, locations, crossings, posts/feed, gatherings) — all green. No critical or minor bugs found in the new features.

action_items: (Optional, pre-existing) Fix Dashboard.js ~line 349 button-in-button nesting that triggers React hydration warning (open-missed-connection-modal wraps a shadcn <Button>).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4495 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, gallery, discover, etc.) for maintainability.

Discover endpoint already returns 'match 145' style chips in UI — the UI string says 'match 145' which appears to be a score value; consider a friendlier label like 'Match score: 145' or show only when meaningful.

POST /api/gallery: image moderation runs synchronously and fails open on timeout (good); however no max file size check before base64-encoding into Mongo — large uploads could bloat documents. Consider 5–10MB cap.
Storing base64 data URLs in Mongo is acceptable for MVP but does not scale; plan a switch to S3/object storage before public launch.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded demo data (12 users, 36 locations, 4 gatherings). Tests are idempotent: any uploaded gallery photo is deleted in the same test, and any privacy mutation on Luna is restored to 'public' in a finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discover + Gallery features are fully verified. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_discover_gallery.py covers all new endpoints + regression. Re-run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_discover_gallery.py -v`. The only outstanding issue is a pre-existing hydration warning on Dashboard (button-in-button) — unrelated to this iteration.
